ptl.wa.top.title: Topic Marker (は)
ptl.wa.top.description: Indicates the topic of the sentence. Often translated as 'as for' or 'speaking of'.

ptl.ga.subj.title: Subject Marker (が)
ptl.ga.subj.description: Indicates the grammatical subject that performs the action or exists in a state.

ptl.wo.obj.title: Object Marker (を)
ptl.wo.obj.description: Indicates the direct object of a transitive verb.

ptl.ni.loc.title: Location of Existence (に)
ptl.ni.loc.description: Indicates the location where something exists or the destination of movement.

ptl.de.loc.title: Location of Action (で)
ptl.de.loc.description: Indicates the location where an action takes place.

aux.teiru.prog.title: Continuous Aspect (ている)
aux.teiru.prog.description: Indicates an action currently in progress (e.g., 'is eating').

aux.teiru.result.title: Resultative Aspect (ている)
aux.teiru.result.description: Indicates a state that persists after an action has been completed (e.g., 'is married', 'knows').

aux.souda.hearsay.title: Hearsay (そうだ)
aux.souda.hearsay.description: Indicates that the information was heard from someone else. Often translated as 'I heard that...' or 'They say...'

suf.tachi.plural.title: Plural Suffix (たち)
suf.tachi.plural.description: Makes a noun plural, specifically for people or animate objects.
